row.proto: float Ai_ErsTable_SampleDelta(void *table, uint32_t group, uint32_t mode, float key, float f0, float f1)
row.notes: Returns 0 unless group < 5 and mode < 4. Base index b = mode + (group==3 ? 4 : group==4 ? 8 : 0); curves are vector table+0x70 (stride 0x10, ptr +8), three per b at keys k0 < k1 < k2: idx b, b+0xc, b+0x18. Each curve: key float +4, samples +0x18..+0x20 evenly spaced over 0..1. D(curve) = F(f1) - F(f0) with linear interpolation of the samples (last sample beyond the end). key == k1 -> D(b+0xc); key < k1 -> lerp D(b)..D(b+0xc); key > k1 -> lerp D(b+0xc)..D(b+0x18) by (key - k_lo)/(k_hi - k_lo), no clamp. Callers: Ai_Select_ErsDeployMode (mode 1, key car+0x74, 0..1, compared with car+0xb4) and Ai_Ers_DecidePushReasons (mode 2, key car+0x74, 0..1-progress). (corrected 2026-11-14: was a single-curve sample at fraction param_5; it is a curve delta F(f1)-F(f0) bracketed over three keyed curves.)
